strings.en: Phew, the Campbellians have settled down... Case closed!
Huh? What's with the gloomy faces, everyone?
Not every problem's been solved yet, you know, Hyoma.
That's right. Thanks to your work, I think we can say the Campbellians
have been defeated, at least for now. But...
In the end, we never learned their connection to the Einst.
And Joe and the others are still missing, too.
You have no idea at all where they went?
Joe Maya and the rest
of the Elshank crew... what's become of them?
Still no contact with them?
I have a rough idea.
Garrison, old man, is that for real!?
They're safe!?
There is interference from Minovsky particles.
And that device was meant to send entire cities to a base on Mars.
That being the case...
...Space... You mean Mars?
Very perceptive, Kyosuke. Though it may not be Mars, mind you...
That's one heck of a big-scale story.
A whole district of Kyoto, sent into space... Bold of the Meganoids.
If you ask me, they're just sloppy.
Commander Hazuki?
Yes, it's about time.
By our math, the colony will soon reach its point of no return.
Tokita, what's the colony's status?
Its orbit is still unchanged. At this rate... it will fall on South America.
Smack onto Jaburo... is that it?
It's so frustrating... All we can do is watch...
Perhaps it's time we discussed how we'll move after it falls...
I guess so. I want to believe in Londo Bell to the very end, but...
C-Commander!!
Hm? What is it, Yuiry!?
The monitor...!
Wh-What is this...!?
Wiseman, got a second...?
What is it, Rain?
Look at this...
Whoa! A Zaku and a Gundam, lined up side by side!!
So the repairs are finished!?
...!! The MS-06S... the repairs are finished!?
...!! The G-3 Gundam... the repairs are finished!?
Yes, though it took a while.
Hmph. I doubt such outdated machines will be of any use.
The Red Comet and the White Devil... Wow, what a sight...!
This Zaku only has about 30% more output than a regular one,
but I hear it moved at three times the speed of a normal Zaku.
The point is, it's the pilot that matters, not the MS's specs.
The Gundam is the very symbol of the Federation!
Just having one here like this is worth something!
W-Well, I suppose I can see your point...
Now it's just a matter of who'll pilot them.
Chris in the G-3, and me in the Zaku... That settles it, right?
When it comes to Zaku pilots, it's gotta be me, right?
The G-3... Chris might want to pilot it...
Sigh... Do as you like. Talk it over with the Commander...
Commander Hazuki! What's going o... Ah!
This is...
That's way too big. What the heck is it?
...Jesus...
This... is not a magnified image?
What's this island that looks like it's made of iron!? Is it flying!?
Amazing... It's easily the size of a small island...!
An island made of steel...!? Is this yet another new enemy!?
Where is it headed!?
At present, it seems to be over the Atlantic.
It's coming straight for Japan... in other words, for us.
Old man! This is no time to be calm! What're we gonna do!?
Ho ho. Ah, the young.
Doing something about it is precisely why I have asked you all here.
...A crafty old man.
Sayin' that don't change nothin', we gotta do somethin'!
Where the heck was somethin' this huge hidin'!? It don't make sense!
True... There's a limit to what you can hide.
Maybe... it was disguised as a small island or something?
Sheer size can make it hard to see what something really is.
What a sight... Man.
The surface world has weapons like that...!?
I wonder how many times bigger than the Wil Wiph it is?
Huh!? Someone's cutting into the special channel!?
I trust you are well... you fools of the Gandor Team...!
Eek!
A-An oni...?
You're... Burai! Emperor Burai!
Indeed. Your battle with the Campbellians was splendid.
They seemed to have some strange allies on their side,
which made them rather hard to lay a hand on.
So you're out to reap the spoils while we do the fighting...!
Ugh, how dirty...
Precisely... It's the basis of war.
The Campbellians are beaten, and your strength is depleted as well...
Now is the perfect opportunity.
Dammit! We sure as hell didn't fight for your sake!
Howl all you like.
As your reward, I shall at least give you time to flee.
With this fortress island I'll seize Japan first... Go wherever you please.
Hahahahaha!
...The transmission's been cut.
Emperor Burai... He's underestimating us!
Commander Hazuki, let's intercept! We can't let them do as they please!
Damn right! If he thinks he can take it all the easy way, he's dreaming!
We fight to the end. Saves us the trouble of searching for them...!
Commander Hazuki, that's what they say, but...
I think intercepting something that big with our forces is impossible.
I think pulling back once is also an option.
Commander Hazuki, please make a decision.
This will test your skill as a commander, Commander Hazuki.
...Very well. The Gandor will now storm the enemy fortress island...!
What!?
Commander Hazuki!?
Yahoo! Charge! Charge!
What's "storm"? What are we doing?
Aren't we supposed to intercept it!?
We don't have time to wait until it's over Japan.
And if they make landfall, whether we win or lose,
the cities will suffer heavy damage...
But...
Now that's more like it! Commander Hazuki, you're a real man!
...Let's do it.
W-Wait a moment, are we really going to board it?
That's right, Commander! Please, calm down...
And we only just finished tuning up Getter Dragon...
Some debut. Straight onto the big stage.
I believe I'm perfectly calm.
Besides... precisely because it's so big, diving into its heart
gives us a better chance of finding a way through.
...What do you think, Captain Amuro?
...I'll leave it to you.
Captain Amuro, you're agreeing just like that...?
Somehow, I had a feeling it'd come to this.
Heh... It doesn't feel like we're fighting a war.
Hahahaha!
I see, so this is the reckless lot I've been up against all this time!
...No wonder I couldn't win!
Colonel... You don't have to laugh that hard...
No, it's amusing! It's been a long time since a battle stirred my heart...!
Forgive me, everyone.
It seems I'm the Cyber Beast Force's commander through and through...
Heh... I happen to like this kind of all-or-nothing gamble.
